generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Translate the task or build contract into implementation goals, interfaces, write scope, acceptance conditions, and prohibited changes.

contract.purpose_user_function: Present an executable builder with the contract goals, interfaces, write scope, acceptance conditions, and prohibitions.
contract.valid_inputs: Task/build contract, selected plan node, context, capsule/operator binding, allowed paths/effects, acceptance and evidence obligations.
contract.expected_outputs: Execution envelope/instruction and builder artifacts/result that preserve contract traceability.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes dispatch/envelope/prompt artifacts; actual builder may modify only authorized workspace scope.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing/invalid contract, unresolved binding, scope/prohibition conflict, or absent acceptance obligations blocks dispatch.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Envelope/plan compilation is shipped; no standalone generic BuildContractInterpreter class was found.
contract.success_evidence: Builder instruction contains exact goals/scope/prohibitions/acceptance and any out-of-scope write is rejected by gates.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: valid contract; missing field; scope allowed/denied; prohibited change; acceptance/evidence propagation.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
